notes.title: Hotfix V0.10.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hot Fix[/h2]

Good day, settlers. 
This is an update log for V 0.10.1

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the prologue didn't play, causing Nyans not to visit. 
The prologue will now play on your next start if it was skipped (No worries. This won't reset your progress)
[*] Fixed missing text for some languages (Russian, Chinese, Japanese)[/list]

notes.title: Settlement News: Feature Update (V 0.10.0)
notes.content:
[h2]Settlement News: Feature Update (V 0.10.0)[/h2]

Good day, settlers. I hope you're all doing well. 
It's getting cold, so make sure to stay warm. 

I've brought you the latest news from the settlement. 

[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]

[b]Room Customization[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45163027/f83c6914c2d580b7a12add837f4131d8a1a602eb.gif[/img]
Galaxy Express has expanded its services and is now delivering room decorations. Customize your bed, rug, curtain and window.  
[list]
[*] 35 new unlockable room decoration items
[*] Christmas-themed decoration and costume for all settlers (no need to unlock)[/list]
[b]Exit to Desktop[/b][list]
[*] "Exit" button on the pause menu allows you to exit directly to the desktop
[*] "To Title" button on the pause menu allows you to return to the title screen[/list]
[b]Dismiss On Click Outside[/b][list]
[*] Clicking outside of a panel will close the panel. 
[*] The feature is disabled by default and can be toggled in the settings[/list]

tags.feature: Christmas-themed decoration and costume for all settlers (no need to unlock)
"Exit" button on the pause menu allows you to exit directly to the desktop
"To Title" button on the pause menu allows you to return to the title screen
Clicking outside of a panel will close the panel.
The feature is disabled by default and can be toggled in the settings

notes.title: New Content, Bug Fixes, and Other Changes (V 0.9.0)
notes.content:
[h2]New Content, Bug Fixes, and Other Changes (V 0.9.0)[/h2]

Good day, settlers. I hope you are doing well.
I've brought you the latest news from the settlement.

[h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Galaxy Express has introduced 20 new customization items 
[*]5 new skin colors are now available for settlers
[*]8 more types of Nyans have been discovered and will be visiting settlers
[*]9 more achievements to unlock[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Fixed ambient sound panel not closing when 'X' key is pressed
[*]Fixed Tofu characters appearing in Japanese and Chinese localizations
[*]Fixed some achievements reverting to locked status after unlocking[/list]
[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Reduced the number of tomatoes needed to unlock packages[/list]

notes.title: Update V 0.8.3
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fix and Small feature Update[/h2]

Good day, settlers. 
This is an update log for V 0.8.3.

[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Added Pomodoro gauge bar and control buttons (pause, cancel) to status display
[*] Added an Alarm control button (cancel) to status display[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Fixed "Always on Top" status not syncing correctly
[*] Fixed "Always on Top" turning off after full screen to windowed mode switch
[*] Fixed window repositioning after aspect ratio change
[*] Fixed Pomodoro settings defaulting to cycle:0, focus: 0, break:0
[*] Fixed rewards for canceling alarm or pomodoro timer
[*] Fixed double rewards on alarm finish[/list]

[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Improved text visibility[/list]
